title: Native prompts
rules: Use the client's native selector when available.
Return answers as structured workflow input; never write prompt-response files.
When a session_id is returned, resume that exact session without recording approval.

sections.heading: Clarification
sections.body: When decision.kind is clarification, ask only the returned prompts. Continue with answers under `input` and the exact returned session-only resume. `approval: {session_id}` preserves the session; it does not approve the stage.
